title: New Godzilla Trailer Highlights Minus One’s Mechagodzilla
content: The King of the Monsters has had one of the biggest years in the kaiju’s long history. Earlier this year, Apple TV released the second season of Monarch: Legacy of Monsters , bringing monster fans back to the West’s MonsterVerse.
author: ComicBook

title: Alleged Operator of Webtoon Piracy Website Newtoki Extradited From Japan to S. Korea
content: The suspected operator behind Newtoki, one of South Korea's largest illegal webtoon distribution sites, was extradited from Japan to Korea, marking a major breakthrough in its efforts to combat global digital piracy.
author: ANN

title: 'Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Fall 2026 Debut

title: 'Ibitte Konai Gibo to Gishi' Reveals Additional Cast, Theme Songs, First Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Otsuji 's Ibitte Konai Gibo to Gishi ( My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked ) manga revealed three additional cast members, the theme songs, and first promotional video on Friday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on July 8 at 11:30 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia Anime Casts Sumo Wrestlers Tamawashi, Tamashoho
content: CyberAgent revealed on Friday that Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia , the television anime of Tomato Soup 's A Witch's Life in Mongol ( Tenmaku no Jādūgar ) manga, has cast Mongolian wrestlers Tamawashi and Tamashoho (full names Ichiro Tamawashi and Manpei Tamashoho) in the series.
author: ANN

title: 'Kekkaishi no Ichirinka' Reveals Main Cast, Additional Staff, Teaser Promo for Winter 2027
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kureha 's Kekkaishi no Ichirinka ( Bride of the Barrier Master ) novel revealed the main cast, additional staff, a second teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video on Friday. The anime series will premiere in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Kagurabachi Anime Reveals Chihiro Rokuhira Character Visual and Trailer
content: The upcoming KAGURABACHI anime adaptation revealed a new character visual and trailer for the protagonist, Chihiro Rokuhira. The highly anticipated anime is set to premiere in April 2027, while it will have its world premiere next month during Anime Expo 2026.
